spans.s:
mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Nocturnal, relating to the night; or a person, &c. doing any thing by night.
E.
निशा night, and अण् aff.; also with ठञ् aff. नैशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं).

A fixed festival; as at birth, investiture, marriage, &c.
E.
निश्चित, certain, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-धः-धी-धं)
Relating to NIṢADHA.
m. (-धः)
A name of NALA.
E.
निषध the country so called, aff. अण्.

n. (-र्म्मां)
1 Abstinence or exemption from acts or their consequences.
2 The salvation obtained by abstraction in opposition to that obtained by works.
E.
निष्कर्म्मन्, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Worth a hundred Niṣkas, bought with them, &c.
E.
निष्क, and शत a hundred, ठञ् aff.; also with सहस्र a thousand नैष्कसहस्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं).

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Bought with, made of, &c. a Niṣka.
m. (-कः)
The mint-master.
E.
निष्क a weight of gold, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Wicked, evil doing, malignant.
E.
निष्कृति, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Relating to state or condition.
2 Belonging to the character or office of a perpetual student.
3 Firm, fixed.
m. (-कः)
The Brahman who continues with his spiritual preceptor, and always remains in the condition of the religious student.
E.
निष्ठा certainty, ठक् aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Severity, cruelty.
E.
निष्ठुर, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Natural, innate.
E.
निसर्ग nature, ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A swordsman, a soldier armed with a sword.
E.
निस्त्रिंश a sword, aff. ठक्.
